profile.headline: Kotlin Engineer @ Ford | Spring Boot, GCP, Postgres
profile.summary:
As a software engineer at Ford Motor Company, I assist in migrating a Kotlin/Spring Boot codebase from using Azure to GCP, developing front end features with React, and adding and updating API rest endpoints in Spring Boot applications. I also enjoy pair programming to give and receive help on tickets and learn from my peers.

I graduated with a bachelor's degree in mathematics from Metropolitan State University in May 2021, where I developed strong analytical and problem-solving skills. I also have intermediate skills in Node.js and Git, and I am always eager to learn new technologies and frameworks. My goal is to create innovative and user-friendly software solutions that improve the lives of customers and stakeholders.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Participate in the entire software development life cycle, including requirements analysis, design, coding, testing (test driven development), debugging, and deployment of spring applications. 
Front end development with react updating components and deploying new features on ford fleet website 
- Adding/updating/migrating api rest endpoints in spring boot applications for ford fleet service such as applying unit conversions on telemetry data sent to front end for data visualization 
- Migrated multiple apps from kafka to pubsub for high volume messaging
- Deployment of apps with CI/CD pipelines (jenkins) and triaging production issues using splunk 
- Created unit tests in Junit, Mockito, and MockK and local integration testing using Docker
- Migrating services from using Mapbox to Google Maps API for large scale geocoding

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Migrated multiple out of date apps to spring boot framework
• Built RESTful API’s in spring apps with Java and Kotlin for back end applications
• Make additions to functionality of front end UI of IOT platform using React

positions.title: Intern Software Engineer
positions.description:
Assist in software architecture development, prototyping, debugging and testing
Introduction to coding in Java, Spring Boot, React, React Native, Nodejs
Introduction to Agile work environment
